propositions: compact.py exceeds 800 LOC with high cyclomatic complexity (CCN 24-21) due to bundling compaction transaction, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI surface in one god command

Splitting compact.py into three modules (facade, transaction engine, rebuild engine) with acyclic dependency graph (compact → {txn, rebuild}, rebuild → txn) prevents circular imports while decomposing by responsibility

All snapshot primitives (_git_author, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, _git) must colocate in compact_txn.py to allow both _compact_locked and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log to import them without cycles

Counter globals _REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count must move together to compact_rebuild.py because rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log does global _REBUILD_COUNT, making get_rebuild_count read a silent zero if left in the facade

Public and test import paths must remain stable via re-exports from compact.py (rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, get_rebuild_count) with no changes to external consumers
Test seams in test_compact_negative.py monkeypatching _git and lock must be repointed to their new homes (compact_txn._git, compact._lock) after module split
